On a bustling opening, rules for the trainers
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: to keep companion animal travel safe, orderly, and humane while supporting guests and flight operations.

The desk shall review each request with calm judgment and courteous care, and the handlers shall use quiet movements, secure equipment, and gentle language at all times. The senior coordinator shall oversee daily service decisions, confirm that records are complete, and resolve exceptions without delay. Staff shall treat every animal as a living passenger deserving dignity, and shall never use forceful handling when a simpler humane method will do.

For bird transport, the desk shall apply the required fee and shall confirm the crate standard before acceptance. <<FACT F059>> The crate must be clean, stable, and free from sharp edges, and staff shall inspect doors, latches, and ventilation before any animal is accepted. <<FACT F071>> If a crate or carrier appears unsafe, the desk shall decline the booking until the issue is corrected. The desk shall also verify that the traveler understands the acceptance terms and that all papers are legible, current, and consistent with the reservation.

During flight, the cabin team shall monitor the animal compartment or cabin placement as assigned, and shall report any concern at once to the senior coordinator. Staff shall keep communication respectful with the traveler, including André Nguyen or Khalil Costa when either is present, and shall never promise acceptance before the review is finished. If a pet such as Mia shows distress, the desk shall document the event promptly and arrange the safest reasonable response.

Any uncertainty, discrepancy, or welfare concern shall be escalated at once to the senior coordinator, and all staff shall follow the approved record trail before release or transfer. For further guidance, contact the senior coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
